- WETH utilization 86.73% (idle 323k WETH), borrow APR 2.60%
- rsETH reserve: 365,444 rsETH supplied, LTV 72%, active
- Aave rsETH oracle 1.04329 ETH
- rsETH totalSupply 549,453

The position is WETH supply only, no debt. Utilization at 86.73% is somewhat elevated but not extreme — withdrawals are still possible (idle 323k WETH available). Borrow APR 2.60% is low. Nothing anomalous: rsETH reserve active, oracle reporting a price, totalSupply consistent.

Is there anything risky here? Utilization 86.73% means 13.27% of WETH is idle — liquidity for withdrawals exists. For a supplier with no debt, the main risks are: protocol exploit, oracle issues (doesn't affect WETH supply without debt), bad debt (no debt so no liquidation risk). High utilization slightly affects withdrawability but 323k WETH idle (~$800M+? Actually 323k WETH ≈ $1B) is plenty.

So risk: low. Action: hold.

Reasons: pure WETH supply, no debt, no liquidation risk; utilization elevated but ample idle liquidity for withdrawals; no anomaly in oracle or reserve status.
